strengths: Good use of type hints throughout the codebase
Context managers are used appropriately for resource management

concerns.concern: Error handling uses generic Exception in many places
Missing async context manager support for streaming

recommendations.title: Use specific exception types
recommendations.problem: Generic Exception catches make error handling difficult for users
recommendations.current_approach: raise Exception(message) for various error conditions
recommendations.proposed_approach: Create specific exception hierarchy (ClientError, ValidationError, StreamError, etc.)
recommendations.rationale: Allows users to catch specific errors and handle them appropriately

recommendations.title: Add async context manager protocol for streams
recommendations.problem: Users must manually close streams or use try/finally
recommendations.rationale: More Pythonic API and prevents resource leaks

questions.question: Should we maintain backwards compatibility with the current exception types?
questions.context: Users may be catching generic Exception - breaking change

questions.question: What is the expected behavior for unclosed streams?
questions.context: Should we warn, raise an error, or silently cleanup?
